note: Level 6 contrast sets (same shape as consonant-contrasts.json). Words in one set share their consonant sounds and differ only in the vowel sound: Magic e vs short vowels (cap / cape), each long vowel vs vowels learned earlier, air/are/ore vs other r-vowels. Only spellings taught up to that unit. Every word has audio (Word Mapper, or 母音偵探 = absolute URL).
